name: sq_point
description: Unit square, Dirichlet everywhere with FLUX-FREE data (psi = 0 on the boundary), pressure fixed by a point constraint p_h(x0) = p(x0) at x0 = (1/2, 1/4) (an interior vertex of every level).

conventions.f: -div sigma_form - gamma grad div u (= -div sigma_form for these fields)
conventions.traction: g = sigma_form n, n the outward unit normal
conventions.grad_div: gamma (div u_h, div v); gamma in viscosity units, not scaled by mu
